description: This PHP source file defines the TaxRate controller class within the Opencart e-commerce system. It manages tax rate tasks such as generating tax rate lists, retrieving specific tax rate info, and clearing related JSON files, for the administration panel's catalog task management.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Controller class that manages tax rate related tasks such as creating scheduled tasks, exporting tax rate data to JSON, and cleaning up generated files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates scheduled tasks for each geo zone to handle tax rate info actions.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed tax rate information for a specified geo zone, generates a JSON file with the data, and handles errors related to missing or invalid geo zone IDs.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes all generated JSON tax rate files in the specified directory.
